services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: Leave the beachfront behind and continue across the water toward beautiful Deer Island. From the helicopter, you'll see the island's natural shoreline, surrounding Gulf waters and the Biloxi waterfront stretching into the distance. The Deer Island Run offers the perfect combination of flight time, scenery and value-making it an excellent choice for couples, families and returning flyers. Important Information: Tour distances are approximate. Flight paths, direction and visible landmarks may change because of wind, weather, air traffic and operational requirements. All flights are weather permitting. Elite Helicopter Tours offers breathtaking aerial adventures over Biloxi's stunning Gulf
